neighbours.label: the self-referential 'meta' / higher-order prefix (metacognition, meta-level, meta-symbol, higher-order)
fire: Teachers can build metacognition by asking students how they solved a problem.
A metacognitive habit helps readers notice when they stop understanding a text.
Linguists call a language used to describe another language a metalanguage.
The proof works at the meta-level, reasoning about the rules themselves.
Flavell's early work on metacognition shaped decades of research on learning.
The notation is a meta-symbol, not part of the formal system itself.
Students practise higher-order thinking by evaluating their own arguments.
Her essay is a kind of metafiction, a story about writing stories.
quiet: Teachers can build confidence by asking students how they solved a problem.
A careful reading habit helps readers notice when they stop understanding a text.
Linguists call a language used by traders from several regions a pidgin.
The proof works at the formal level, reasoning about numbers directly.
Flavell's early work on child development shaped decades of research on learning.
The notation is a symbol of the formal system and is used everywhere.
Students practise careful thinking by evaluating the arguments of others.
Her essay is a kind of short fiction, a story about a seaside town.
